name: Followup Blow (Combat, Critical)
body:
You can use a critical hit from one weapon to create an opening for another.

Prerequisite: Dex 15, Two-Weapon Fighting, BAB +6.

Benefit: When you are able to make an attack with each hand (as a result of either fighting with two weapons, having a hand free to make unarmed attacks, or having the Improved Shield Bash feat) and your primary weapon scores a critical hit, you can make an attack with your off-hand against the same target as an immediate action, without taking any two-weapon attack penalties. You gain a +1 bonus on your attack roll for this attack if the weapon with which you scored the critical hit has greater than a x2 critical multiplier.

Special: You can apply the effects of only one critical feat to a given critical hit unless you possess Critical Mastery.
